text: Tightened latent sketch method typing. LatentSketchMethod now distinguishes IdentityResponse from ContiguousVoxelAveraging; IdentityResponse validates only when the component request covers the full voxel selection, while compressed plans must opt into ContiguousVoxelAveraging. LatentSketchAssignment enforces the same boundary during preparation so internal execution cannot bypass plan validation. Updated direct and future-chunked compressed LatentSketch tests to use the explicit method, and added a model-level rejection test for the formerly ambiguous fixed-component identity config. Evidence: sbt modelJVM/test modelJS/test fitJVM/test fitJS/test passed 16/16/121/116; scoped diff check clean; trailing-whitespace scan clean. Remaining: true latent/shared-basis backends, reduced-rank GLS covariance/inference bundles, and fmrireg lowrank/rrr fixture parity.
